verified_behaviors: server-owned bounded context delivered to model as untrusted data
no client-supplied history or privileged roles
user/session/conversation isolation including two active sessions for one user
inactivity, snapshot reset and logout during inference
failed/concurrent turns do not pollute memory
old monetary claims do not count as current evidence
earlier action requests do not grant current capabilities
UI context indicators, reset notices and old-snapshot answer hiding
limitations: No live model conversation-quality acceptance, per local-only preference.
Existing assistant/evidence audit records retain their prior persistence; only conversational context is volatile.
Restarting the server loses context, and owned persisted conversation IDs resume with empty memory.
Saved history, long-term preferences and action execution are deferred.
